fixture.description: Two ordered, overlapping flat opaque XYZ|DIFFUSE UP triangles with distinct captured world, view and projection matrices.

result.comparison: D3D8 baseline, captured D3D8 and D3D12 replay P6 PPM bytes match.
result.image_note: Lossless RGB conversion of the reference PPM.

replay_sensitivity.description: Separate DX12 replays swapped draw order or changed the second draw world, view or projection independently; each was compared with the saved replay.
replay_sensitivity.note: Mutated packets and images were temporary; this tests sensitivity, not parity of modified scenes.

limitations: Isolated synthetic UP fixture; no TDS frame or gameplay test.
Depth, texture sampling, buffer-bound draws, game shaders, lighting and materials are not tested.
RGB equality on this runtime does not guarantee general D3D8 parity; PPM omits alpha.
No native Windows D3D12 GPU, swapchain presentation or GPU timing was validated.
